chapter.heading: 1 Corinthians 6
Lawsuits Against Believers
chapter.v: instead of the saints?
the saints will judge the world? And if the world is to be judged by you, are you incompetent to try trivial cases?
Do you not know that we are to judge angels? How much more, then, matters pertaining to this life!
why do you lay them before those who have no standing in the church?
I say this to your shame. Can it be that there is no one among you wise enough to settle a dispute between the brothers,
but brother goes to law against brother, and that before unbelievers?
Why not rather suffer wrong? Why not rather be defrauded?
your own brothers!
neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor men who practice homosexuality,
nor thieves, nor the greedy, nor drunkards, nor revilers, nor swindlers will inherit the kingdom of God.
you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God.
“All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are helpful. “All things are lawful for me,” but I will not be dominated by anything.
the Lord for the body.
by his power.
your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and make them members of a prostitute? Never!
“The two will become one flesh.”
becomes one spirit with him.
sins against his own body.
You are not your own,
So glorify God in your body.

footnotes.footnote: 6:9 The two Greek terms translated by this phrase refer to the passive and active partners in consensual homosexual acts
